member.name: T:System.Windows.Input.SpeechCommand
member.summary: Base class for an that can also be invoked by voice, and that ties a phrase to a .

remarks.para: Derive from this class, implement , and , and assign an instance to a button's Command property.

While the button is loaded, the command is linked to it. When the command reports a voice activation by calling , the button raises Click with , which then executes the command. The button's IsEnabled state is combined with to decide whether the phrase is available. A command instance can be linked to only one loaded button at a time.
Voice input requires a Kinect sensor. The button template can define the SpeechHidden, SpeechShown and SpeechDisambiguating visual states to show the phrase on screen.
